name: Survival — refuelling checkpoint
description: Seed 42 at tick 4200, before the former starvation at 4490. Preserves the complete world and RNG state; reset returns to 4200. Uses shared game rules.

name: Body language — fold over rich food
description: A cross must fold around its neighbours to cover a rich square patch.

name: Body language — balanced feeding
description: Two similar feeding positions: observe settling and resistance to repeated reversals.

name: Body language — leave depleted food
description: Almost empty food underfoot and a fresh patch nearby: persistence must not prevent departure.

name: Body language — two food patches
description: Fixed small world: reach, gather, feed, then leave for the second patch. Shared game behaviour; no random food or regrowth.

name: Grazing underfoot
description: Food beneath the organism: inspect feeding and adjustment with the shared game rules.

name: Feeding reshape
description: An asymmetric five-cell body beside a fixed food patch. Inspect changes in food contact and shape.

name: Compact birth
description: Compact organism on an authored map. Uses the same growth and movement rules as the game.

name: Staged refuelling
description: Travel between small refuelling patches, shedding cells under stress. Matches the 120-tick acceptance test.

name: Baseline seeded ecology
description: Generated food world, seed 42, with the normal regrowth, spreading and spawning rules. This uses the same initialization as longevity testing.
